newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: bauMAX posts lower first half earnings.
newsitem.headline: bauMAX posts lower first half earnings.

text.p: bauMAX AG, Austria's market leader in the do-it-yourself sector, said on Wednesday group net profit in the first six months slipped 0.35 percent from the year-ago period and pre-tax profit fell 11.7 percent.

First-half net profit reached 84.7 million schillings ($8 million) , pre-tax profit dropped to 131 million schillings from 148.3 million as group sales fell to 2.84 billion schillings from 2.85 billion in the year-ago period.

In a statement released ahead of its earnings conference at 0800 GMT, bauMAX said it has revised down its full-year forecast for sales to 7.2 billion schillings from its initial forecast of 7.5 billion. In 1995, the company posted sales of 6.8 billion. It gave no further earnings forecasts.
bauMAX said competition within the Austrian market had intensified due to the entrance of German do-it-yourself operators.
Moreover, construction slowed down in the first half due to Austria's long and cold winter just as consumption was dampened by the government's savings package.

bauMAX said the integration of its Buettinghaus acquisition made in June 1995 was concluded successfully, with sales from Buettinghaus accounting for 17 percent of total sales in the first six months. -- Julia Ferguson, Vienna newsroom, +431 531 12 254 ($ = 10.64 Austrian Schillings)
